add.title: 🔧 Why the list is 3× too long (the system fix)
add.text:
Three ways one question shows up several times:

1. **A plan handed down waits twice:** once on the agent that wrote it, once on the agent that handed it down (items 1 and 2, 4 and 5, 6 and 16).
2. **An agent's whole session shows as waiting** whenever one of its tasks waits (items 16, 17, 19, 20).
3. **One task is listed twice:** at its own folder and again at its parent's folder (items 9–11 repeat 12–14).

And one wait outlives its answer: a merge step still "waits" 17 days after its work landed (items 7, 8).

The fix belongs in the "waiting" list's code, not in closing items by hand: count a wait once, at the task that holds it.
